557:t_123:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll stop your twisted world reform, $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$!」

557:t_124:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't look away from the past! Overcome it!」

557:t_124:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「You think I'd fall for a slogan like that?」

557:t_124:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm not running from the past. I'm only trying to conquer it.」

557:t_124:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't think you're the only one living with wounds!」

557:t_124:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I won't let a coward like that do whatever he wants with people's lives!」

557:t_125:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「The $$ラプラスの箱$$ that $$ガンダム$$ points to... All that waits when it's opened is despair.」

557:t_125:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You know what the $$ラプラスの箱$$ really is!?」

557:t_125:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「I had my dealings with $$フル・フロンタル$$, to a degree.」

557:t_125:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「But what sleeps inside it goes beyond even his expectations...」

557:t_125:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「This is my last warning. If you survive, seal it away.」

557:t_125:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't listen to the words of someone who runs from the present age like you!」

557:t_125:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We fear neither the past nor despair! We stake our hope on the possibility called the future!!」

557:t_126:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「Looks like there's someone here too who throws the word 'future' around irresponsibly.」

557:t_126:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「I won't hand a world that so many people are bleeding to protect over to a man who flees to the past like you...!」

557:t_126:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Then I'd like you to be grateful. That the Empire will fall by my hand.」

557:t_126:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「What we must do isn't defeat the enemy! It's bring peace back to this world!」

557:t_126:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「I won't let you destroy this world we must protect with your selfish logic!」

557:t_127:0.en:
$$シン$$
「What you're trying to do is one-sided slaughter, worse than war!」

557:t_127:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「But my plan will end the war, with both sides sharing the pain.」

557:t_127:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「I leave what comes after to you. Do as you like with this world.」

557:t_127:3.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm not going to accept words like that!」

557:t_127:4.en:
$$シン$$
「If you want to go to the past, go alone! But you dragged others into it, so you're my enemy!!」

557:t_128:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I know, $$キラ・ヤマト$$. That you too live with regret.」

557:t_128:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「But I'm alive. To move on past the sorrow, to what lies beyond.」

557:t_128:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're admirable. Since I can't be like that, I'll do as I please.」

557:t_128:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「Taking someone's life for that can't be allowed.」

557:t_128:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「So I'll stop you! So that no one else has to taste my regret!」

557:t_129:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「What a shame, $$赤い彗星$$. That I can't see how it ends between you and $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

557:t_129:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「So your Earth-wide indiscriminate slaughter was $$フル・フロンタル$$'s trump card.」

557:t_129:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「His clear-eyed pragmatism is worth emulating. Otherwise, you can't lead this world.」

557:t_129:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Efficiency and rationality are, in the end, an intellectual's empty theory. You can't move the world... or people with that!」

557:t_129:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「Your selfish world reform is the same! Don't think you can do as you please with people's lives by logic!」

557:t_130:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Target confirmed. Attack objective: $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$.」

557:t_130:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Neither I nor this $$ベリアル$$ comes so cheap that we'd fall that easily.」

557:t_130:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But whatever means I have to use, I'll take you down. For this world...!」

557:t_131:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I never thought you'd side with the $$赤い彗星$$. I suppose you're only a woman after all.」

557:t_131:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You who flee into the past wouldn't understand. What it means to stake everything on the future.」

557:t_131:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Fine, $$ハマーン・カーン$$. But you too will learn that what awaits in the future is despair.」

557:t_131:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「And you'll regret leaving $$フル・フロンタル$$'s side.」

557:t_132:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「I've met plenty of guys who preach selfish logic, but you're the first to remake the world for it!」

557:t_132:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's just that this was the only way to fulfill my wish.」

557:t_132:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's how deep the despair I tasted was.」

557:t_132:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I can't measure your despair by my own yardstick...」

557:t_132:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「But if you're going to take the lives of everyone in the world for it, I'll stop you!」

557:t_133:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Before you line up your logic, listen to my soooong!!」

557:t_133:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「If I could have lived like you, that might have been happy...」

557:t_133:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「But I chose this path. I won't let anyone get in my way.」

557:t_134:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Stop the plan right now! Do you understand what you're doing!?」

557:t_134:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Of course. But there's nothing to be sad about.」

557:t_134:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't decide who gets to live by your own logic! There's no sorrow greater than having your life taken!」

557:t_134:3.en:
$$レド$$
「If you won't stop, I'll make you by force! For the people living in this world too!」

557:t_135:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「So it was you who came after all.」

557:t_135:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Get out of the way. I'm going to pick up $$千鳥$$.」

557:t_135:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「So I'm not even worth your notice.」

557:t_135:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「What a coincidence. I'm here for the same reason.」

557:t_135:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「But if you get in my way, that's another matter.」

557:t_135:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's more like it...! This time I'll kill you right in front of her!」

557:t_135:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「With this, the plan will...」

557:t_135:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no intention of indulging your idle talk! Let's go!」

557:t_136:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$. If you had backed my plan, this would have gone much more easily.」

557:t_136:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you know me, you should understand that it's a pipe dream.」

557:t_136:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Come to think of it, it's absurd. That the two sharpest minds in the world should end up settling things by force like this.」

557:t_136:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If it's to stop your twisted plan, I'll use any means...!」

557:t_136:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And I'll protect this world...! For the people who dreamed of a future too!」

557:t_137:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「Causality is warped in this space. Your power as an $$異能生存体$$ might not work either.」

557:t_137:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even you seem to have grown afraid of dying. Then...」

557:t_137:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no intention of dying.」

557:t_137:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll live in this world. You, who get in the way of that, are my enemy.」

557:t_138:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I've used your data too, as reference for this $$時空修復|lc$$.」

557:t_138:1.en:
$$桂$$
「If you're saying $$オルソン$$ and I are involved parties too, I'm casting my vote against this plan.」

557:t_138:2.en:
$$桂$$
「Nobody has the right to do a $$時空修復|lc$$ on their own say-so! I'm saying that much at least as the original $$特異点$$!」

557:t_138:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Words like that won't stop me. I passed the stage of being bound by morals long ago.」

557:t_138:4.en:
$$桂$$
「If you're going to spout the standard villain lines like that, I can go all-out by force too! Get ready, Mr. Genius!」

557:t_139:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「Here's another one living with regret.」

557:t_139:1.en:
$n
「Investigating a nobody like me... For such a grand plan, you sure had time to spare.」

557:t_139:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Not really. But $c... you in particular... have caught my interest in a number of ways.」
